Actor2
Hey there! Corruption has struck! The skull clan continues
to wreck havoc! And the princess has gone mad in clover
palace! You will need all the information you need to
stop them and purge corruption!
Actor2
You can press ESC to access your menu. From there you will
find lots of things to do, but the important ones are
SAVE and FORMATION.
Actor2
Use FORMATION to change your party! You can only have 3
people in your party so decide who that'll be. For your
reference, your starting party is Moggy, Wolfie, and Judah.
Actor2
In the SAVE option, you can save your game. This game DOES
NOT have autosave, so make sure to save often to avoid losing
progress if you were to fall in battle.
Actor2
That's about it, explore these buildings before leaving.
The one next to your house is the info center, allowing
you to read up on the world or combat. The other buildings
are shops or other homes.
Actor2
I wish you the best of luck!
